title: Exports
subtitleAll: Every contact and lead export in your company
listHelp: Files are deleted 24 hours after they are made. The record of each export, with its purpose, is kept. Only the person who asked for an export can download it.
emptyDetail: Exports you make from the contact or lead lists appear here for 24 hours.
contactsIncluded: The file lists reference, name, type, roles, primary phone and email, preferred channel and language, office, owner, source, marketing consent and dates, for contacts you may edit.
leadsIncluded: The file lists reference, dates, status, type, source, contact name, phone and email, listing, office, assignee, response and next action, for leads in your scope.
neverIncluded: Never included: identity, tax or bank numbers, notes, activity text or enquiry messages.
purposeHelp: Why you need this file, for example "Q4 landlord mail-out". It is recorded in the audit log. Up to {max} characters.
purposeTooShort: Enter a purpose of at least {min} characters.
excludeWithdrawn: Leave out contacts who withdrew marketing consent
governance: At most 50,000 rows. The file is deleted after 24 hours and every download is recorded.
ready: {count, plural, one {Export ready: # row} other {Export ready: # rows}}
downloadHelp: The download link works for five minutes. Keep the file only as long as you need it.
failedDetail: Nothing was saved. Try again, or narrow the filters.
